mu_name: The arrow a Kanturu Iron Rider looses
why_this_one: MODEL_IRON_RIDER_ARROW, which AttackEffectKanturu1stMonster creates at the rider's IRON_RIDER_BOW_6 at CheckAttackTime(10) (GM_Kanturu_1st.cpp:704-710). game/fx/iron_rider.h draws it.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Effect/ironobj.bmd, from MuMain's clean Data: two meshes, 80 triangles; about 1.3 m long and half a metre across at MU's size, drawn at 0.5 and growing.

parts.note: Data/Effect/whitemark_R.OZJ, 8 x 8: the bolt's white core. Drawn RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT at BodyLight (0.8, 1.0, 0.8) (ZzzObject.cpp:1664-1668).
Data/Effect/motion_blur.OZJ, 32 x 64: the streak behind it, added the same way.

scale_from: Scale 0.5 at its birth, times 1.05 a frame; LifeTime 12 at 70 units a frame; its light down by 0.7 a frame over its last five (ZzzEffect.cpp:506-519, MoveHandlers.cpp:281-300).
